root.name: Scandinavian Defense: Anderssen Counterattack
root.moves: 1. e4 d5 2. exd5 Qxd5 3. Nc3 Qa5 4. d4 e5

overview: After 4.d4 e5 Black counters at once, with the queen on a5 pinning the c3-knight. 5.dxe5 wins a pawn and Black gets quick development (...Nc6, ...Bb4 or ...Bg4) and pins against it; 5.Nf3 (the Goteborg System) lets Black play ...e4 or ...exd4 with a messy centre. White usually keeps the extra pawn and consolidates, so Black has to prove the compensation. I know this line only roughly.

white_ideas.idea: Take 5.dxe5 and consolidate the extra pawn with Nf3 and Bd2
Break the pin on c3 and complete development
Aim for a better endgame a pawn up

black_ideas.idea: Use the pins on c3 with ...Bb4 and ...Bg4
Develop fast with ...Nc6 and ...Nge7 and attack the e5 pawn
Hit e5 before White can consolidate

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with the e-file and d-file open after dxe5
Black queen on a5 and bishops pinning the c3-knight

character.notes: Concrete play with early pins and an extra pawn at stake; the queen is exposed.

gambit.notes: After 5.dxe5 White keeps the pawn if he can consolidate; Black is playing for development.

soundness.notes: Engines tend to favour White; Black's compensation is unclear, so risky.

structure.notes: Pawn exchanges on e5 and d4 open the centre and the e-file.

level.notes: Concrete lines must be known, and Black must also judge the compensation.

sublines_that_differ.name: Goteborg System
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 d5 2. exd5 Qxd5 3. Nc3 Qa5 4. d4 e5 5. Nf3
sublines_that_differ.how: White does not take on e5 and keeps the tension.

character.reason: Black plays on pins and development for a pawn; one slip loses quickly.

gambit.reason: After 5.dxe5 Black has given a pawn for development.

soundness.reason: Black's compensation is doubtful; engines prefer White.

structure.reason: Central pawns come off and the e-file opens.

level.reason: Concrete theory with a risky evaluation; not beginner.

plans.reason: Black's compensation is development with an early queen.
